facts: Syntax-based statistical machine translation aims at applying statistical models to structured data.
MT stands for syntax-based statistical machine translation.
The paper presents a syntax-based statistical machine translation system.
The syntax-based statistical machine translation system is based on a probabilistic synchronous dependency insertion grammar.
Synchronous dependency insertion grammars are a version of synchronous grammars defined on dependency trees.
The paper introduces an approach to inducing a grammar from parallel corpora.
The paper describes a graphical model for the machine translation task.
The graphical model can be viewed as a stochastic tree-to-tree transducer.
The paper introduces a polynomial time decoding algorithm.
The outputs of the machine translation system are evaluated using the NIST and Bleu automatic MT evaluation software.
The machine translation system is evaluated using the NIST automatic MT evaluation software.
The machine translation system is evaluated using the Bleu automatic MT evaluation software.
The syntax-based statistical machine translation system outperforms the baseline system based on the IBM models.
The syntax-based statistical machine translation system outperforms the baseline system in translation speed.
The syntax-based statistical machine translation system outperforms the baseline system in quality.
